en.hubeali:
A number of our companion, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ibn Abu Najran, from Al A’ala, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> and Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
both having disliked sailing the sea for the business’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Khalid from ibn abu Najran from al-‘Ala’ from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, and abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, have said, ‘
We dislike sailing on the sea for business.’”
